rule: Shares listed by T-Invest on 2026-11-09 with currency=rub, api_trade_available_flag, liquidity_flag, first_1day_candle_date <= 2020-12-31 and at least one dividend between 2020-01-01 and the selection date. The liquidity flag is today's state and biases the sample towards survivors; that is accepted and recorded (ADR-033, p. 13). An issuer whose payout was announced and later cancelled stays in the list (not_paid events are kept), so a cancelled dividend does not remove the ticker. The list was frozen before any result of the idea was seen; changing it after a run is a new attempt in the journal.
